ME1 was the first game to combine CRPG and shooter mechanics. Its execution of both was mediocre. The universe they built was interesting enough to keep players hooked until the end of the game.

ME2's story was wonky compared to ME1, but the gameplay was slightly better. It already cashed in on the multi part series effect, where people see it through rose tinted glasses because they liked ME1.

ME2's gameplay was streamlined. There was no menu hell like ME1 and the cover system worked infinitely better than ME1. In ME1 it was like oh, I'm fighting Geth now? Dives into menu to switch all ammo type to bullets that have a buff against synthetics. Now I'm fighting krogans? Dives into the menu to switch all ammo type to bullets that have a buff against organics. Bugs are next? Dives into the menu to find ammo with a high impact to keep them at bay with knockback. You had to pause and kit out your squad accordingly for every enemy comp you faced if you wanted to play optimally.

You started a mission in ME2 and there was no inventory management. You had your loadout you picked before the mission began and that was it. Combat in ME3 was even better than ME2, but kind of forgettable. I just enjoyed wiping entire groups of enemies on Insanity as an infiltrator. Whoever had the idea to give the stealth class a sticky grenade is a goddamn genius. Snipe, cloak, move, snipe, incinerate, stick, snipe, cloak, point blank SMG spray, incinerate, snipe, stick, etc. If you got in their face an SMG was as good as a shot gun.

Story was best in the first game and got progressively worse, but 2 had the best and most memorable characters by design of the plot.

I played and enjoyed all three as they came out. For their time they were as good as AAA games got story-wise. Each one had a couple of characters that I really liked a lot (Wrex in ME1, Solus in 2 and 3, and Garrus in 3), and the setting was done really well. I'm going to reserve my judgment on 4 until I play it, but it certainly looks like a shit-show from the outside. Then again, it's one of those things that's become politicized for bullshit reasons, so I'm going to reserve my judgment on how the game actually is for when I play it.
